scenes.text: He left college at 19. Now he makes about *six figures a month* talking about AI.

scenes.title: Who: *Maverick Maltin*, 19
lines: Studied digital marketing at Arizona State for one year.
Left in May 2025 to make AI videos full time. His parents, both founders, backed him.
His dad worked in tech and put ChatGPT in his hands early.

scenes.title: The *AI* part
lines: He shows people aged 30 to 65 everyday ChatGPT uses: prompts, selling garage stuff, interview prep, discount codes.
His motto: make AI as simple as possible for everyone.
Early on he even had AI review his own brand contracts.

scenes.title: The *growth*
lines: First TikTok in May 2025. An early video hit a million views.
Posts twice a day now, up to four a day at his peak. Consistency is his hardest part.

scenes.title: The *numbers*
lines: First brand deal: $2,400 for two videos, after months of building trust first.
Over 100 brand deals since. Brand deals are 100% of his income.
Now signed with an agency, with a video editor and a legal team.

scenes.label: a month, *for the last few months*
scenes.sub: BUSINESS INSIDER REVIEWED HIS FINANCIAL DOCUMENTS

scenes.title: His *advice*
lines: Don't reinvent the wheel. Copy what works and add your own style.
Hire help sooner than you think. He waited too long.
"Understanding it more than the person next to you puts you ahead of 99% of people." Business Insider, July 30, 2026.

scenes.text: Who do *you* know that needs AI explained simply? Tag them.
